$comment: Slots of sections/accent.ts (UI lock: staging v5/sections/accent/NOTES.md; the three cards: staging v5/graft/lime/NOTES.md, lines at 1440, 1024, 768 and 390). Before the edge, on white: tab (a tab label, sans 16, one line) and gap (a two-word line in the display face, 72px / 40px, one line). On the full lime screen: h2a + h2b (two-tone H2, 64px / 40px; one line each at 1440; at 390 one line up to about 20 characters, two at the budget), sub (sans 20 / 17, two lines at 1440, three at 390), and three cards in one row, a Session's life between turns in this order: Sandbox (what goes), Files and conversation (what stays), Resume (how it comes back). Label 16 w500, one line; line 15, at most two lines, balanced (accent.css): write each line as two phrases of about the same length, and join with a no-break space (\u00a0) what must not be split across lines (Session ID, working directory, Live processes; ja: the particle after a Latin word). The five parts of a Session (harness, model, sandbox, files, resume) are the spec table's, so the cards do not list them again. Budgets: tests/home-copy-slots.test.mjs (en characters, zh / ja full-width widths). Sources: $source below; the tab, gap, H2 and sub: staging v5/content/NOTES.md.

$source.h2: v4b's line. The sandbox is reclaimed once idle (docs/prd/session-lifecycle.md L8); the Session has no inactivity deadline (SPEC §4 L60) and continues after the sandbox was reclaimed (SPEC §4 L53).
$source.sub: A turn succeeds only when a checkpoint of its workspace and native conversation commits with it, and failed or cancelled turns never replace the last one (SPEC §4 L46, L49); the next input restores it, on a fresh sandbox once the old one was reclaimed (session-lifecycle.md L8).
$source.cards: Sandbox: a sandbox left idle is reclaimed automatically (session-lifecycle.md L8; SESSION_RUNTIME_IDLE_GRACE_MS = 5 min, apps/api/src/modules/runtime/domain/session-runtime-policy.ts L2), never before the turn's checkpoint commits (SPEC §4 L47); live processes, sockets and machine-wide temporary state are never carried over (SPEC §4 L54). Files and conversation: v4c's audited 'Files and conversation restored'; a later turn finds the working directory, files outside outputs/ included, and the harness's native conversation (SPEC §4 L53; README L26; session-files.md L9). Attachments never enter a checkpoint (SPEC §4 L54; session-files.md L16), so the line names the working directory, as the stage's Resume line does (v5 truth review P1-1). Resume: the Thread ID is the one handle (SPEC §4 L38) and the same Session ID continues (SPEC §7 L82); a reply days later has the same semantics after the sandbox was reclaimed, and the next input restores it on a fresh sandbox (SPEC §4 L53; session-lifecycle.md L8; 'fresh sandbox' is v4c's audited wording).

en.sub: Every successful turn ends in a checkpoint. The next turn resumes from there.
